system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Binding Chains

The Blood of the Uzumaki Clan manifests within you, differently, not with sealing techniques, but with unyielding determination and willpower. Once per turn, when casting a Jutsu you know, you can select one of the following benefits;

Full Power. If the jutsu you cast would inflict ranks of a condition, you can spend 1 Spiral Cell, to increase the ranks of the inflicted condition by +1.

Controlled Power. If the jutsu cast requires concentration, you can spend 2 Spiral Cells to treat it as two different jutsu you are concentrating on, effects that would trigger once as part of casting from a class or clan feature, now trigger twice for this jutsu’s casting.

Energizing Power. As part of casting this jutsu, if a creature fails their saving throw by 5 or more, you regain 1 Spiral Cell.

Beginning at 7th level, you can apply two different effects. This increases to all listed effects at 15th level.
